mit_candidate.position_reference: exact integral of piecewise-held upper joint velocity
mit_candidate.velocity_reference: latest upper joint velocity sampled on bus grid
mit_candidate.gain_semantics: Analytically selected effective simulation gains; not real servo readback or qualified 0x4B/0x4C encoding

gain_selection.rationale: Choose Kd so normalized b+Kd is at least 1.4 times the largest negative derivative of the frozen sliding friction branch; keep Kp and all physical interface parameters unchanged.
gain_selection.scope: Conditional sliding-branch incremental damping criterion; not a proof of complete sampled-loop or loaded 24V hardware stability.
